name: collagen type VI alpha 3 chain

function.text: COL6A3 encodes collagen alpha-3(VI) chain. Annotated molecular activities include serine-type endopeptidase inhibitor activity and extracellular matrix structural constituent conferring tensile strength. It participates in muscle organ development and response to glucose.

germline.text: Retained constitutional disease associations include collagen 6-related myopathy (autosomal dominant); collagen 6-related myopathy (autosomal recessive). Pathogenicity and inheritance depend on the specific allele and disorder.

somatic.text: Somatic sequence alterations have cohort-level candidate-driver evidence in Melanoma. This gene-level statistical evidence requires allele-specific review and does not establish the effect of every variant.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
Autosomal recessive; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Cohort-level candidate sequence driver in IntOGen (combined q<0.1; at least 3 mutated samples). Statistical association does not classify an individual allele.
